note: Annual retirement of two councillors in each ward of Londonderry Corporation; nominations Monday 6 January 1930. There was no opposition anywhere, so there was no poll. No nominations were made for the West Ward, whose retiring councillors, William Quigley (L.) and Bernard Doherty (L.), were deemed re-elected; that ward is not recorded here as an election (Derry Journal, 8 January 1930). The retiring Labour councillors were C. H. M'Gahey and J. F. Rooney; no papers were lodged for Rooney, and five minutes before the close William M'Gahey nominated himself. Returned unopposed.
